status: Shared cooperative mip preparation promoted after local correctness review. Full migration, performance and release acceptance remain open.

problem.rootCause: Large cold minified source scans and box averaging ran synchronously in a render callback. Uniform 8K×4K×2 and checker fixtures reproduced long main-thread occupancy. Tool/skin-only redraws also unnecessarily invalidated source pixels.

implementation: PixelTileCache draw and prepare share one generator. Synchronous callers drain it; preparation yields at source-row boundaries with a conservative65536 source-pixel work budget. Maximum validated source width32768 fits this bound.
UI uses a4ms soft deadline and one owned MessageChannel per pending render. This is not a4ms hardware/task guarantee. Work and scratch are resumed or released through the same cursor.

Source dirty ownership transfers once. New document, edits, camera, frame/layer count or context changes cancel/re-key work. At most one cut transform is prepared before ordinary rasters within the existing64tile/128MiB logical cache budget.

Prepare does not paint the destination; a complete frame is published synchronously. New pointer drawing is held while preparing; pan/zoom and commands remain available and can supersede the request. Existing release/cancel continues.

Failure preserves authority/history and preflight backing; partially painted failures reset Canvas. Context loss remains not-ready until restore. Cancel closes ports, releases scratch and rejects stale callbacks.
Tool and skin-only updates preserve warm source caches. Actual pending commits already request full pixel invalidation.

boundaries.newAbstractions: Only shared traversal and render/error/channel resource ownership; sequential UI work remains inline.

tiles.scope: Independent raw/box reference, transform/unaligned/odd edge/large factor, bounded continuation, cancellation and allocation/upload/context failures.

publicPreparation.scope: Public UI document/Undo/Redo/camera supersession, preserved backing, warm tool/skin, synthetic context loss and injected ImageData failure. Main Canvas readback optionfalse is test-only; not physical GPU loss or performance evidence.

scene.scope: Same source cache, bypassed final scene capture reference; not an independent mip oracle or timing evidence.

native.scope: Actual macOS normal UI4 app without benchmark overlay; original assertions/fixtures preserved in temporary foreground adapter. These timing fields are not performance acceptance.

chrome.scope: Fresh desktop Chrome, native resource profile, 256MiB authority; not mobile/physical pen/RSS/p95. Callback observers add overhead. Paired delta median differs from difference of medians.

nativeUniform.scope: Actual WK direct fixture; identical geometry/raw/Canvas/request quality. Common v3 overlay adds1s startup stabilization; activation helper finishes before measured work. Not comparable numerically with Chrome open/activation intervals.

nativeChecker.reason: DPR2/backing1904×1436/mip4 versus DPR1/backing952×718/mip8; timing/upload/Canvas comparison is invalid. No automatic retry or performance improvement claim.

performance.decision: Accept bounded responsiveness with explicitly slower completion in observed pairs. Initial50ms, tail latency, broad/disjoint dirty, matched-DPR WK checker, long-session/RSS and physical device gates remain open.

diagnosticsPreserved.earlierBrowserPrototypes: UI1 timer→rAF had1608ms completion against193ms; MessageChannel reduced this to446ms; row checkpoints reduced it to232ms. These n1 snapshots remain separate from final UI4 repetitions.
diagnosticsPreserved.fractionalReadback: Original redo Canvas mismatch also reproduced byte-identically on baseline. Explicit true and false readback-policy controls both matched all stages. Product context options unchanged; no proven Undo defect or measured backend transition.
